title: termix-mcp access policy
description: Defines named access profiles for termix-mcp. A profile is selected by bearer token (HTTP transport) or by TERMIX_PROFILE (stdio), and scopes which machines a caller may reach, whether it may write, which tools it may call, and which paths it may touch.

defaultProfile.description: Profile used by the stdio transport when TERMIX_PROFILE is unset. Must name a defined profile.

profiles.description: Named profiles. The key is the profile name used by TERMIX_PROFILE and shown in audit records.

comment.description: Free-form notes. Ignored by the server.

mode.description: How this dimension is scoped. 'allowlist' denies by default and permits only what `allow` matches (deny carves exceptions out) — fails closed. 'blocklist' permits by default and refuses what `deny` matches (allow carves exceptions back in) — fails open. 'all' applies no restriction. 'none' refuses everything. If omitted, the mode is inferred: allowlist when `allow` is non-empty, blocklist when only `deny` is, otherwise the dimension's default (hosts: allowlist, tools and paths: all).

ruleSet.description: A rule set may be written three ways: the string "all"/"none"/"allowlist"/"blocklist"; an array, which is shorthand for an allowlist of those patterns; or an object with mode/allow/deny.

description.description: What this profile is for. Shown by the help tool, so write it for whoever reads it later.

token.description: Bearer token selecting this profile on the HTTP transport. Prefer tokenEnv or tokenSha256 so the policy file itself carries no secret.

tokenEnv.description: Name of an environment variable holding the bearer token.

tokenSha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the bearer token.

termixApiKey.description: Termix API key used for this profile instead of the global one, so Termix's own host ownership enforces the same limits at the source. Prefer termixApiKeyEnv.

termixApiKeyEnv.description: Name of an environment variable holding this profile's Termix API key.

mutations.description: 'deny' pins the profile read-only; toggle_state cannot lift it.

globalBlocklist.description: Whether the server-wide TERMIX_BLOCKLIST still applies to this profile. 'ignore' lets a profile reach hosts excluded globally, and is warned about at startup.

hosts.description: Which machines this profile may reach. Patterns match a host's NAME or its IP, case-insensitively; '*' is a wildcard. Defaults to allowlist, so a host added to Termix later is unreachable until granted. Use "all" to leave machines unrestricted.

tools.description: Which tools this profile may call. Patterns are tool names with '*' wildcards, or a group: @readonly, @hosts, @files, @files.read, @files.write, @exec, @docker, @system, @tunnels, @snippets, @observability, @meta, @escape. Defaults to unrestricted.

paths.description: Which filesystem paths the file tools may touch. Paths are canonicalized before matching, so traversal cannot escape a grant. '*' stays within one segment, '**' crosses separators, and a bare prefix covers its subtree. Defaults to unrestricted. NOTE: path rules only bind the file tools — a profile that also grants @escape (run_command, find_file, run_snippet, call_api) is not truly path-restricted.
